extracted.intended_audience: CIG/CIA administrative staff and participating departmental cable originators
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative procedures for procuring, delivering, securing, accounting for, and distributing departmental cables within the C.I.G. (trial implementation at a specified center).

rubrics_metrics.name: Uniform system for procurement, delivery, security and accounting
rubrics_metrics.description: The objectives of this order are to establish a uniform system for the procuring, delivery, security and accounting of departmental cables to CIG.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establish consistent processes and controls across participating departments covering how cables are procured, delivered, secured, and accounted for within CIG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimize administrative burden
rubrics_metrics.description: To reduce as much as possible the administration incident to the other cables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures should be designed to minimize administrative work associated with handling cables (e.g., reduce redundant processing, streamline routing and recordkeeping).

rubrics_metrics.name: Expedite flow to required recipients
rubrics_metrics.description: To expedite the flow of cables to those who require them in the performance of their duty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize timely delivery and routing so recipients who need information for duty performance receive cables quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trial implementation and phased effectivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Particulars of this order will be put into effect on a trial at C8G3, 17 December 1946.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures are to be tested at the named trial location and date before wider rollout; record trial results and adjust procedures as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial procurement and handling of copies in prescribed quantities
rubrics_metrics.description: Initially, copies of cables will be procured and handled in quantities as indicated below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Begin operations by procuring and processing cable copies in the specified initial quantities; implement required actions and liaisons (OCU to initiate necessary actions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution within CIG subject to origin department instructions and security procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless otherwise specified by the department of origin, it will be understood that each cable is available for distribution within CIG in accordance with O01G needs, subject only to established security procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distribute cables throughout CIG to meet organizational needs except where the originating department restricts distribution; all distribution must comply with established security controls and classification handling rules.
